proposal.description: The capture gate is closed whenever UVLO is live, so every UVLO is treated as a routine power-down rather than only the ones that come after the converter has stopped
proposal.reason: If UVLO asserts while the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN, the UVLO bit is never set. Any cause that is live on the same clock (OTP, OVP, latch_assert, window trip) is lost too, and so is the episode start time: fault_reg stays empty and fault_time stays 0 where the original records them.

proposal.description: UVLO is recorded only during soft start, on the belief that a UVLO in S_RUN is the routine power-down the capture gate is there to ignore
proposal.reason: A UVLO that interrupts S_RUN leaves the UVLO bit clear in fault_reg. If UVLO is the only cause, the record stays empty, but fault_time is still latched because episode_start still counts uvlo_state. A UVLO during S_SS is recorded as before.

proposal.description: OTP is recorded only in S_RUN, on the assumption that the board can only overheat under regulated load current, so an over-temperature during soft start is forgotten
proposal.reason: If otp_state asserts while ss_active is high and run_active is low, the OTP bit is not set. episode_start still fires on otp_state, so fault_time is stamped while fault_reg stays empty, or holds only the other causes.

proposal.description: OVP inference is suppressed while UVLO is live, on the assumption that the SCR readback is not trustworthy during a brown-out
proposal.reason: If, while running, the latch reads back set with latch_assert low on a clock where uvlo_state is also high, the original records both OVP and UVLO. The mutant records UVLO only, so the analog overvoltage trip is missing from fault_reg.
